nodes.summary: The decision problem 3-DIMENSIONAL MATCHING accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a 3-dimensional matching instance $(n, T)$ that is well formed (every coordinate of every triple in $T$ is less than $n$) and feasible (it has a perfect matching). Bitstrings that do not decode to an instance are rejected.
nodes.title: 3-DIMENSIONAL MATCHING as a decision problem

nodes.summary: A 3-dimensional matching instance $(n, T)$ is feasible, or has a perfect matching, when there is a list $M$ of length $n$, obtained from the list of triples $T$ by deleting some of its entries, such that for each of the three coordinate positions, every natural number $a < n$ occurs in that position in exactly one triple of $M$.
nodes.title: Feasible 3-dimensional matching instances

nodes.summary: An instance of 3-DIMENSIONAL MATCHING is a pair $(n, T)$ of a natural number $n$, the part size, and a finite list $T$ of triples of natural numbers.
nodes.title: 3-dimensional matching instances

nodes.summary: The decision problem 3-DIMENSIONAL MATCHING on bitstrings is in NP, and every decision problem in NP reduces to it by a polynomial-time many-one reduction.
nodes.title: 3-DIMENSIONAL MATCHING is NP-complete

nodes.summary: A 3-dimensional matching instance $(n, T)$ is well formed when each of the three coordinates of every triple in $T$ is less than $n$.
nodes.title: Well-formed 3-dimensional matching instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
